full_name: Rich Benjamin | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Journalism & Nonfiction Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Independent Scholar
bio: Rich Benjamin is a cultural anthropologist who researches contemporary US politics and culture, specializing in democracy, social relations, space and place, demographics, and race.
